I know this sub is probably a bit small and maybe not interested in futball but I wanted to share my thoughts and I understand that I have the opposite view of pretty much everyone elses opinion so I just wanted to leave this here where maybe not that many people will get riled up about it. Here goes. I could not be happier with Mexico's win today over Panama. Coming into this tournament it looked like we would not make it anywhere in this tournament. Mexico played against Guatemala and Cuba and the defeat over Cuba seemed expected but barely beating Guatemala showed that Mexico was not doing very well. The game against Trinidad y Tobago showed Mexico had so many weakness's. But Mexico had still won. Today Mexico looked terrible. Mexico literally has one play. Give it to guardado and let him run it all the way up and lose it or let him pass it before the box and have it get intercepted. Without Giovanni Dos Santos and Chicharito on the field our offense pretty much has nothing. Our Defense is lack luster. But our goalie is amazing and his new hair cut is fabulous. Anyways today before the game started I would have never guessed Mexico would have won. Today before the game I wondered if we would lose with dignity and at least score 1 point or if we would lose without putting up a single point. When the guy from Panama was given a red card I thought it would be easier but Panama played with more intensity and urgency. I thought Mexico would lose with an extra man. That would have been embarrassing. Cutting to our first PK, I don't worry about the call. The ref has made his decision and I accept that it can't be changed regardless on if the call helps or hurts my team. In this game PK's can be stopped or even better a counter attack can be made to reclaim the lead so I think Panama had nothing to worry about. But I was excited, Mexico was back in the game! The game could still be won. I felt embarrassed for my country at the Aguilar dive after getting poked in the chest and how I wish we could have subbed him out. Panama had so many scoring opportunities and Mexico had so little. In the end it came down to a second PK. Again the ref made a decision and the linesmen didn't do anything about overturning it so it would be another PK. Guardado shot a beautiful one just as he had done before. In the end Mexico played a great game and aside from Aguilar I'm proud of the men and they should be proud at themselves because they are all talented athletes which is a feat not many of us get to show on such a big stage. For someone like me who will never get to see a game live, who will never get to have my voice matter on how the national team run, and who realizes that i will never be a professional player, all i wanted is to see my team win and to see the men be graceful in victory and defeat so that they may be good role models for my kids. I think it's shameful that a Panamanian player pushed the ref and I think it's shameful that the Panamanian team wanted threatened to stop playing and I think it's shameful the Panamanian team threatened the ref so much after the game he had to be escorted out by security. As kids we see this game and it gives us hope and inspires us. The players whether winning or losing need to understand that their biggest fans are all under the age of 13 and these fans idolize them so they need to act with integrity and respect not only to their teammates but to everyone else on the pitch. So today I am happy with the Men's national futball team for Mexico (aside from Aguilar). And I hope my children can grow up to be outstanding men like what Guardado and Ochoa seem to be on the field. Thank you if you read all of this.
